description: This file defines the PermissionsClient class, a C++ wrapper around gRPC stubs for a permission service. It provides methods for enumerating, getting, granting, setting, revoking, deleting permissions, and other operations related to application permissions via remote procedure calls. It includes necessary headers, class constructors, and method declarations for interacting with the permissions service.

classes.name: PermissionsClient
classes.description: A client class encapsulating gRPC interactions for permission management, including methods for permission enumeration, retrieval, updating, and authorization.

methods.name: PermissionsClient
methods.description: Constructs a PermissionsClient targeting a specified permission service endpoint with optional TLS and timeout settings.

methods.name: PermissionsClient
methods.description: Overloaded constructor allowing explicit channel credentials for more advanced setup.

methods.name: ~PermissionsClient
methods.description: Destructor, cleans up the PermissionsClient instance.

methods.name: EnumeratePermissions
methods.description: Enumerates permissions for a specified app, given various identifiers and filters.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the application permissions object for an app.

methods.name: Grant
methods.description: Grants specified bundles and permissions to an app, updating its permissions.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets (replaces) the permissions for an app with provided bundles, includes, and excludes.

methods.name: Revoke
methods.description: Revokes specified bundles and permissions from an app.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the permission record for an app.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Authorizes a session token against specific permission filters.

methods.name: GetAllForApp
methods.description: Retrieves all permission entries associated with an app.

methods.name: GetAllAppKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all app keys known to the permission service.

methods.name: GetThorTokenRPC
methods.description: Acquires a Thor token for attribution to a specific app.

methods.name: GetRegisteredPermissions
methods.description: Fetches all registered permissions in the catalog.

methods.name: RegisterPermissions
methods.description: Registers new permissions, potentially replacing existing ones.

methods.name: Endpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint string this client is configured to connect to.
